consultation.ai.progressiveSubtitle: Listen, review, generate, then fill the consultation. One step at a time.
consultation.ai.captureStepHelp: During the encounter, Joprelys preserves the transcript continuously. The clinical form appears only after you validate the generated report.
consultation.ai.dictationProgressiveHelp: Dictate a passage, stop to save it, then continue as many times as needed.
consultation.ai.transcriptStepHelp: Correct or discard older passages that should no longer participate in the clinical report, then generate the summary.
consultation.ai.deleteTranscriptConfirm: Remove this passage from the next clinical report?
consultation.ai.deleteTranscriptFailed: This passage could not be removed. It remains preserved and will still be taken into account.
consultation.ai.deleteAllTranscriptsConf: All these passages will be removed from the next clinical report. The action remains auditable.
consultation.ai.deleteAllTranscriptsFail: The passages could not be removed. They remain preserved and will still be taken into account.
consultation.ai.noTranscriptRemaining: No passage remains for this clinical report.
consultation.ai.noTranscriptRemainingHel: Resume recording to add new information.
consultation.ai.reportStepHelp: Usable information is preserved even when the clinical report is incomplete. Review it, then complete only what is missing.
consultation.ai.reportPartialHelp: Joprelys preserved the sufficiently grounded facts. You can validate them now or complete missing information before filling the form.
consultation.ai.formReadyHelp: The clinical form is now available for your final review before saving.
consultation.ai.tipDictateNaturally: Tip: speak naturally. Each sentence is preserved as it is received.
consultation.ai.realtimeCorrectionFailed: The correction could not be saved. The previous transcript remains preserved.
consultation.ai.realtimeDurableIntakeBlo: Secure persistence is interrupted. The microphone is paused without deleting queued sentences.
consultation.ai.reportEmpty: The transcript remains preserved, but Joprelys could not automatically structure these elements. Review the passages or add more recording; nothing has been lost.
consultation.ai.reportGenerationFailed: The clinical report could not be generated. The complete transcript remains safely stored.
consultation.ai.captureLoadFailed: The saved transcript could not be reloaded. Do not continue until data access has been restored.
consultation.ai.vitalsRequireDedicatedVa: Detected vital signs still require confirmation in the Vital Signs section.
consultation.entry.title: Start the consultation
consultation.entry.subtitle: Choose how to enter the consultation to begin.
consultation.entry.chooseTitle: How would you like to enter the consultation?
consultation.entry.manual.title: Manual entry
consultation.entry.manual.summary: Fill in the clinical form directly.
consultation.entry.manual.help: Open the form to enter your observations. You can review them before saving the consultation.
consultation.entry.manual.second: Complete the note, prescriptions and tests
consultation.entry.dictation.title: Dictation
consultation.entry.dictation.summary: Dictate your observations, then review the transcript.
consultation.entry.dictation.help: Start the microphone to dictate a passage. Stop dictation to review and correct the transcript before preparing the form.
consultation.entry.conversation.title: Conversation with the patient
consultation.entry.conversation.summary: Record the conversation to prepare the consultation.
consultation.entry.conversation.help: Start recording when you are ready. You can then review the transcript before filling in the clinical form.
consultation.entry.microphoneFootnote: The microphone will only activate after your click and permission.
consultation.entry.manualFootnote: The consultation is only saved when you choose to save it.
consultation.entry.dictationUnavailable: Dictation is not available in this browser.
consultation.entry.formOpenHelp: Complete the fields below and review them before saving.
